blurb: East Hartford Golf Club offers an 18-hole golf course with practice facilities including a putting green. The clubhouse has a pro shop with golf equipment and apparel, rental clubs, and a dining area overlooking the 18th hole. The course welcomes golfers of all levels and offers memberships with various benefits.
